integrity_notes: Analytical proof for all stated sizes; finite explicit checker is supplementary. Originality judged from inspected primary sources and semantic scientific comparisons only. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The complete energy polynomial is proved only when the equal part size is not a multiple of three.
For multiples of three the entropy limit is proved by matching exponential upper/lower bounds, not a full blocked-state classification.
Uniform positive couplings, three available colours, equal part sizes, and strictly energy-decreasing single-vertex recolouring only.
No statement on dynamical sampling of traps, quench relaxation, zero-temperature neutral moves or finite-temperature phase transitions.
title: Three commensurability classes of blocked three-colour Potts states on complete tripartite graphs
